purpose: WOGHAW E-02: one provider-neutral WO Workflow Definition, two roles, routed to different engines by a Strategy/routing profile

input.rule: lowercase; replace every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 with a single hyphen; strip leading and trailing hyphens

implement.task: Apply the rule to the input text and produce the resulting slug.

audit.task: Independently check whether the candidate slug `hello-world-example` is exactly the result of applying the rule to the input text.
audit.result: PASS if it is exactly correct, otherwise FAIL
